## What

A one-paragraph summary of the change and the problem it solves.

## Why

The motivation, and a link to the related issue if one exists.

## How tested

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes locally
- [ ] Manual smoke test (`gnosis <url> -o out/`) verified
- [ ] Added/adjusted tests for the changed behavior

## Provenance / product impact

Note any change to the provenance contract (frontmatter fields, hashes, WARC
records) or the CLI surface, since those are the public guarantees.
